content: VERIFIED LOCALLY: Go stdlib has NO TOML parser — 'go doc encoding/toml' fails on the locally installed Go 1.27.0 (/opt/homebrew/Cellar/go/1.27.0). No encoding/toml was added in 1.24/1.25/1.26; golang/go#60791 is about shared struct tags across encoding packages, not TOML adoption. YAML is also not in stdlib. Therefore pyproject.toml and Cargo.toml parsing requires either an external TOML dependency (BurntSushi/toml, pelletier/go-toml/v2) or a minimal hand-rolled subset reader. Note: pyproject.toml is TOML, NOT YAML — gopkg.in/yaml.v3 (already a direct dep via config/) cannot parse it; the question 'is a YAML dep justified for pyproject.toml?' is a category error.
